author: ewen and donabel

source_title: Cathederal with cinco de Mayo street sign

author: Ani Carrington
attribution: Photo: Ani Carrington, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/35506817@N00/5006939357. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted on a pink wall above a doorway, Baja California Sur (San José del Cabo area); 'La' in small script; no accent painted on PALETERIA. Painted ice-cream pictures around it.

author: The Sean & Lauren Spectacular
attribution: Photo: The Sean & Lauren Spectacular, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/50230758@N03/4774071560. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Playa del Carmen building-supplies shop, hand-painted orange fascia cut at the left edge ('[MAT]ERIALES YAM / [P]ARA SU CONSTRUCCION'); a piece of wood covers part of 'ERIALES'. Upper repeat of the name is cut off. Distractors: product list (POLVO, GRAVA, CEMENTO GRIS …), hand-written sheet 'MATERIALES "MARISOL"' with a price/product list and phone numbers, and a MAYA cement logo.

author: Ani Carrington
attribution: Photo: Ani Carrington, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/35506817@N00/5122244224. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: San José del Cabo, painted on the white lintel over the door, first and last S in pink. Heart-shaped board at left repeats 'SalsitaS / BREAKFAST / LUNCH / DINNER / Open Daily …' (hours illegible); house number 1732 at right.

author: Iván Santiesteban
attribution: Photo: Iván Santiesteban, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/29981847@N00/2407855967. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Monterrey, night film photo: long fascia over lit shop windows; the final O is partly blown out by a lamp. Small signs at left (perfumes / peluches / moños, phone 8340-27-01, '…EO MENUDEO') and a small sign over the door are distractors.

author: Ani Carrington
attribution: Photo: Ani Carrington, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/35506817@N00/5122245070. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: San José del Cabo craft shop: hand-painted hanging sign shaped like a piñata at the right corner, soft-focus and small; the tilde on ñ is faint but present. The ribbon under it ('… Mexican Handcraft Boutique') and the painted wall text at left ('Unique Mexican Crafts Boutique', a second piñata sign, a 'CENTRO HISTÓRICO SAN JOSÉ DEL CABO' plaque, 'Bienvenidos' door lettering) are too small or soft to transcribe exactly.

author: rutlo
attribution: Photo: rutlo, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/26809429@N02/6072771988. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Distance board on a pole beside the toll highway (Carretera Cuota 15, Nayarit), with tricolour bird logo; written without accents (IXTLAN, MEXICO). Read as three rows: place, then distance.

author: gabofr
attribution: Photo: gabofr, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/46096359@N00/1474260624. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted street sign in a scrolled iron frame, Tecate, Baja California (postcode 21430). Blue graffiti tag on the sign and a second cut-off sign above ('…ICIA') are distractors.
